verdict.rationale: Zamzar's API docs describe a formats lookup whose JSON response lists the target formats a given source format (e.g. GIF) can convert to, so a pair can be checked before submitting a job. The website also lists named per-pair converter pages (PNG to ICO, PDF to DWG, MP3 to Text) within a stated catalog of 1,100+ conversions. missing for 10: a published full input-to-output conversion matrix, detail on the formats endpoint beyond a single example, independent or hands-on corroboration that the lookup is complete and accurate.
